title: DaySummary
description: The contract for files pushed to the VPS collector. Same schema is used by the Tauri app's pre-push validator and the collector's --validate / --once modes.

wins.description: List of completed work or positive outcomes

people.description: List of people worked with (already anonymized to category placeholders if use_generic_categories is on)

open_threads.description: List of in-progress items to track

voice_notes.description: Verbatim voice transcripts captured that day
